applied.problem: Several claims are wider than true: every drive does not bring all three effects (low-harmonic IGBT front ends exist); filters limit, not stop, emissions; 6n±1 only holds for a balanced supply; six-pulse drives without chokes exceed 40%; the 8% ship limit is voltage THD and may be relaxed if docume…

The worked example puts drives on an RCD without saying the 440 V supply is earthed, contradicting the step to disconnect the filter on an insulated supply; the ship measurement point is about filter failure, and the 3.5 mA rule is about high protective conductor current.

At exactly five time constants the link is 540 × e^−5 = 3.6 V, not about 3 V; at 5 and 15 minutes it is 3.5 V, so tie the 3 V to those times. Screen 5 states the 25-40% range as true of every real six-pulse drive; ones without a choke draw more.
